rules.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ah, we meet again. As I foresaw...
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: 啊，我们又见面了。正如我所预见的……

rules.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: This guy looks like a fighter.
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: 这家伙看起来很能打。

rules.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Let's see how you can handle this.
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: 让我看看你如何应付这个。

rules.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: That will be enough for now.
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: 暂时就这些吧。

rules.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You have proven yourself. You may pass.
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: 你们已证明了自己的实力。可以通过了。

rules.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Go and live again!
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: 去吧，重获新生！
[BOSS] The Watcher: 真令我刮目相看。

rules.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Gratz for making it this far, but I'm basically unbeatable.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: 恭喜你们走到这里，不过我可是近乎无敌的。

rules.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: I don't even need to fight, this is the life!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: 都不用我亲自动手，这才叫享受！

rules.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: I can summon lots of undead! Check this out.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: 我能召唤大批亡灵！看好了。

rules.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Oh noes, you got me.. what ever will I do?!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: 哎呀，你们打败我了……这可怎么办啊？！

rules.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Alright, maybe I'm just weak after all..
rules.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: 好吧，也许我确实太弱了……

rules.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: But my masters are a lot stronger..
rules.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: 但我的主人们可强得多……

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: This is where the journey ends for you, Adventurers.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 冒险家们，你们的旅途到此为止了。

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: The last few who tried fighting me are now in those Crypts.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 上几个挑战我的人，如今都躺在那些墓穴里。

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: If you can beat my Undeads, I'll personally grant you the privilege to replace them.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 要是你们能打败我的亡灵，我会亲自赐予你们取代它们的殊荣。

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: I'll make you take the Mage's place!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 我要让你取代我的法师！

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: I'll make you take the Archer's place!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 我要让你取代我的弓箭手！

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Those toys are not strong enough I see.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 看来那些玩具还不够强。

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Don't get too excited though.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 不过别高兴得太早。

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Did you forget? I was taught by the best! Let's dance.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 忘了吗？我的老师可是最强的！来较量一番吧。

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: You'll never beat my teacher..
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 你们绝不可能打败我的老师……

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: His technique.. is too advanced..
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 他的技艺……太高深了……

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I was burdened with terrible news recently...
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 最近，我听到了一个令人痛心的消息……

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My most talented student...
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 我最有天赋的学生……

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I'll show you real power!
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 让你们见识真正的力量！

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: You took one of them down, but that won't be enough!
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 你们打倒了其中一个，但这还远远不够！

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Oh? You found my Guardians' one weakness?
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 哦？你们找到了我的守卫者唯一的弱点？

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Even if you took my barrier down, I can still fight.
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 即使你们击破了我的屏障，我依然能战斗。

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: This time I'll be your opponent!
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 这次，由我来做你们的对手！

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique.
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 我明白了。是你们逼我使出终极秘技的。

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: These Guardians aren't just for show I'm afraid!
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 这些守卫者可不只是摆设！

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: The process is irreversible, but I'll be stronger than a Wither now!
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 这个过程不可逆转，但我将比凋灵更强大！

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: What?! My Guardian power is unbeatable!
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 什么？！我的守卫者之力是无敌的！

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: How could you... I needed more power...
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 你们怎么可能……我需要更强的力量……

rules.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I can't let my Master hear about this.. he'll kill m-
rules.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: 不能让我的主人知道这件事……他会杀了我——

rules.source: [BOSS] Necron: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with..
rules.translation: [BOSS] Necron: 冒险家们！看清楚你们招惹的是谁……

rules.source: [BOSS] Necron: Before I have to deal with you myself.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Necron: 别逼我亲自出手收拾你们。

rules.source: [BOSS] Storm: Don't boast about beating this simple-minded Wither.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Storm: 打败那个头脑简单的凋灵，没什么好炫耀的。

rules.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Little ants, plotting and scheming, thinking they are invincible...
rules.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: 小小蝼蚁，机关算尽，还以为自己天下无敌……

rules.source: [BOSS] Goldor: I won't let you break the factory core, I gave my life to my Master.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: 我不会让你们摧毁工厂核心，我已将生命献给了主人。

rules.source: [BOSS] Goldor: The little ants have a brain it seems.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: 看来这些小蚂蚁还算有点脑子。

rules.source: [BOSS] Goldor: I will replace that gate with a stronger one!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: 我会换上一扇更坚固的大门！
[BOSS] Goldor: 你们的末日就要到了！！

rules.source: [BOSS] Goldor: You have done it, you destroyed the factory...
rules.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: 你们做到了，你们摧毁了工厂……

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 我已无意战斗，但我知道这阻止不了你们。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: We will decide it all, here, now.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 就在此时，此地，了结一切吧。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: You just made a terrible mistake!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 你们犯下了一个可怕的错误！

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: Your skills have faded humans.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 人类，你们的本领退步了。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: My enemies are now my strongest allies!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 昔日的敌人，如今成了我最强大的盟友！

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: My soul is disposable.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 我的灵魂，舍弃也罢。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: Storm was my favorite sparring partner, you must have enjoyed fighting him!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: Storm 曾是我最喜欢的切磋对手，想必你们也很享受与他交手！

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: Oh, this one hurts!
[BOSS] Wither King: This world isn't worth fighting for, how can you be so determined?
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 这个世界不值得为之而战，你们为何如此坚定？

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: Incredible. You did what I couldn't do myself.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 不可思议。你们做到了连我自己都无法做到的事。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: In a way I should thank you, I lost all hopes centuries ago that it would ever end.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 某种意义上，我该感谢你们。几百年前，我就不再奢望这一切会结束。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: I hope you'll become the Heroes I could never be.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 希望你们能成为我未能成为的英雄。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: So long champions of this mad world!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 永别了，这个疯狂世界的勇士们！

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: My strengths are depleting, this... this is it...
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 我的力量正在枯竭，这……就是终点了……

rules.source: [BOSS] Scarf: If I had spent more time studying and less time watching anime, maybe mother would be here with me!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: 要是我当初多花点时间学习，少看点动画，也许母亲就能在这里陪着我了！

rules.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Do you really think we won't repair everything? Your impact will be minuscule!
rules.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: 你们真以为我们不会修复这一切？你们造成的影响微不足道！

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: I am not impressed.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 这可打动不了我。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: I have more of those.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 这样的手下，我还有很多。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: Some of you do have some talent, I can feel it, the other ones not so much.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 我能感觉到，你们之中有些人确有天赋，其他人就差远了。

rules.source: [BOSS] Wither King: I enjoy your passion, if the circumstances had been different, we could have been friends.
rules.translation: [BOSS] Wither King: 我欣赏你们的热忱。若非身处此境，我们本可以成为朋友。

rules.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: A Wandering Soul? Poor guy.
